name: ITEQ Corporation
summary: ITEQ Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of copper clad laminate materials used for fabrication of printed circuit boards in Taiwan, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers mass lamination boards, copper clad laminates, prepreg products, and electronic components, as well as import and export trading of manufacturing equipment.
